transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, lately I just feel like I'm constantly running on a motor. I finish one thing at school, or at home, and... I just immediately jump right into the next. I can't really seem to shut myself off. That's... that's mainly it.
Do you ever have times when your mood feels unusually high or euphoric?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel high or anything like that. Just... busy, I guess.
Do you get thoughts that keep coming into your mind even when you don’t want them to?
No... not really. I don't think so. Just... thinking about the next thing I have to do. That's about it.
Do you often have trouble paying attention, even when you want to?
No, I don't think so. I can focus fine when I need to. I just... I just have a lot of energy, that's all.
Do you often get into fights or break rules on purpose?
No... definitely not. I don't get into fights. Just... no, I don't do things like that.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying?
No, I wouldn't say so. I don't really... dwell on things.
Do you often feel physically restless, like you need to keep moving?

I suppose so, yeah. That's... well, it's kind of what brought me in. I just feel like I'm constantly running on a motor lately. I'll finish something at school, or at home, and... I just immediately jump into the next thing. I can't really seem to shut myself off.
Do other people often tell you that you seem unusually fidgety or always on the go?

Yeah... I suppose they do. Like, in IEP meetings, or my admin classes. I guess my leg is always bouncing under the table, or I'm clicking a pen. Shifting in the chair. I don't really realize I'm doing it until... well, until I see people glancing over at me.
When you feel unable to shut yourself off, is it because your mind is worrying a lot?
No, not really. Like I said earlier, I don't really dwell on things. It's not... my mind isn't spinning with problems or anything. It's just a feeling that I need to keep doing something.
Did you have this same kind of restlessness when you were a child?

Yeah, I suppose so. It's... well, it's been around a long time. My mother used to make jokes about it. She'd say that even back in elementary school, I was the one teaching the class from my seat. Just... always getting out of my chair, or talking, or cutting in before the teacher even finished giving directions. So... yeah. It's just part of who I am, long before adulthood. It's not something that just started with this recent family change or anything.
